dataset_name: SmartRatios Credit Risk Model (credit risk / 1y default probability)
settings: SUBINDUSTRY / decay 4 / trunc 0.08 / nanHandling OFF / pasteurization ON / unitHandling VERIFY
sign_prior: star_sr_* = credit QUALITY percentile (higher = lower default risk). Distress puzzle (Campbell-Hilscher-Szilagyi 2008) => long high quality => POSITIVE rank. Forum post 29155767547543 uses -rank on default-probability-oriented data, which is the same economic direction.
sources: forum 29155767547543 Forecasting Default with the KMV-Merton Model (JL11546, 2025-01-12)
Campbell, Hilscher, Szilagyi 2008 In Search of Distress Risk (distress puzzle)
Asness, Frazzini, Pedersen 2019 Quality Minus Junk (QMJ)

templates.name: KMV-Merton forum skeleton (compressed, conditional neutralize on leverage bucket)
templates.mechanism: time-series rank of credit quality + weighted decay + neutralize within leverage bucket

templates.name: Pure quality level (QMJ baseline, cold raw score field)
templates.mechanism: cross-sectional profitability credit score, no time transform

templates.name: Credit-quality momentum (rating drift, one quarter)
templates.mechanism: Avramov et al. credit rating momentum: improving credit standing predicts positive drift

templates.name: Credit quality vs own one-year norm (z-score)
templates.mechanism: deviation of raw coverage score from its own yearly distribution

templates.name: Idiosyncratic credit risk (sector-relative minus global-relative default percentile)
templates.mechanism: safe vs sector peers but risky globally implies whole-sector distress; captures cross-domain mismatch

templates.name: QMJ core spread (profitability minus leverage)
templates.mechanism: profitable and low-leverage joint quality, the two strongest QMJ pillars

templates.name: Growth per unit leverage (ratio geometry)
templates.mechanism: growth efficiency conditional on balance-sheet risk

templates.name: Credit-quality stability (prefer low volatility of the score)
templates.mechanism: unstable credit standing carries a penalty (uncertainty aversion)

templates.name: Accelerating credit quality (second difference)
templates.mechanism: second-order drift of credit standing, separates turning points from steady states

templates.name: Weakest-link credit quality (min across coverage/liquidity/leverage)
templates.mechanism: default is driven by the weakest dimension, not the sum; nonlinear min geometry
